key_decisions.decision: Attach priest to Jehoiada and retain the separate leadership description.
Keep the succession within the roster without smoothing its chronology.
Retain Elihu as written and his stated kinship.
Retain the inclusive age wording and the ancestral promise image.
Follow the read personal name and distinguish the grazing regions.
Retain the Ishmaelite designation and the animals’ specified sex.
Retain uncle as the kinship reading and keep the princes’ attendant distinct.
Keep the parentage in this direction and the succession of counselors.
